						<div class="post-wrapper">
							<div class="post-body"><div class="post-content un-no-sidebar-layout"><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container onepage-section" data-label="info" data-name="info" id="row-unique-2"><div class="row double-top-padding no-bottom-padding double-h-padding limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-9 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>The accommdation</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-3 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container onepage-section" data-label="Accommodation" data-name="accommodation" id="row-unique-3"><div class="row col-double-gutter single-top-padding single-bottom-padding double-h-padding limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-6 half-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="uncode_text_column" ><p data-start="128" data-end="442">Starting in 2026, we’re excited to kick off a new partnership with Drivethru, bringing our guests to their unique accommodation on Denmark’s stunning west coast. Hidden between the wild North Sea and the calm Ringkøbing Fjord, this private spot is just for us – the perfect base for an unforgettable getaway.</p>
<p data-start="444" data-end="851">Here you’ll find everything you need: cozy rooms with fjord views, a huge 35,000 m² garden to unwind in, and wellness treats like a sauna, hot tub, and massages. The dunes and the surf are only a short walk away, while our private fjord access makes it ideal for kitesurfing. And when you’re not in the water, you can join a workout, enjoy homemade food, or simply relax with friends in the guest kitchen.</p>
<p data-start="853" data-end="955">This is more than a place to stay – it’s a place to recharge, connect, and make memories by the sea.</p>

						<div class="vc_row row-internal row-container"><div class="row row-child"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-12 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="uncode_text_column" ><p data-start="786" data-end="950">Room 5 is designed for 2 guests and offers either 2 single beds or 1 double bed. It includes a private bathroom and is offered as a <strong data-start="931" data-end="947">private room</strong>.</p>

						<div class="vc_row row-internal row-container"><div class="row row-child"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-12 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="uncode_text_column" ><p data-start="952" data-end="1116">Room 6 sleeps 2 guests and can be arranged with either 1 double bed or 2 single beds. It has a private bathroom and is offered as a <strong data-start="1097" data-end="1113">private room</strong>.</p>
